stories.title: Spain’s final election debate focuses on housing crisis
stories.summary: In the final televised debate before Sunday’s election, Spain’s party leaders concentrated on the country’s housing crisis. The campaign has featured protests with jingling house keys and demonstrations that have filled plazas across the nation. Opinion polls indicate that Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is unlikely to win a second term, and People’s Party leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo said he would build a million new homes.
stories.why: The debate matters because the housing crisis has become a central issue shaping voter sentiment ahead of the election.

stories.title: India targets $1 trillion in exports by March 2027 despite US tariff proposal
stories.summary: The secretary general of ASSOCHAM said India expects its total exports to exceed $1 trillion by March 2027. He noted this outlook while acknowledging that the United States is considering a 25% tariff on certain Indian goods.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.previousTitle: India’s exports top $500 billion, growing 15% as US tariff talks continue
stories.previousSummary: ASSOCHAM Secretary General Saurabh Sanyal said India’s exports have already crossed USD 500 billion and are expanding at roughly 15 % per year. He added that a proposed U.S. tariff on Indian goods could be reduced from 25 % to 17 % if ongoing trade negotiations between the two countries are successfully concluded.
